armyRules.name: Pursuit of Perfection
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Perfection has to be seen to count. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Initiative on the turn it charges, but a unit that ends its own turn having neither made a Shooting Attack nor a Charge suffers -1 to its Cool Checks until it does one of them.

armyRules.name: Exquisite Cruelty
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion savours every kill and is dulled by every refusal. A unit with this rule that wins a Combat gains Feel No Pain (6+) until the end of the following turn, but a unit that loses a Combat must make a Cool Check at -1 at once.

armyRules.name: Peerless Duellist
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Character of the Legion cannot resist a stage. It adds 1 to its Initiative while in a Challenge, but if it is slain in a Challenge every friendly Emperor's Children unit within 12" must make a Cool Check at -1.

wargear.name: Laurels of Perfection
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A circlet of gold leaf awarded for a flawless victory, and worn as though the next one were already won. The model gains +1 Cool and +1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Banner of Dissonance
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A standard strung with tuned bells and wire that howl in the wind of the charge. The unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Narcotic stimulants
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cocktail of synaptic boosters that turns pain into pleasure and orders into noise. The unit gains Feel No Pain (6+) and every model suffers -1 Willpower.

wargear.name: Mirrorbright plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Armour polished until it throws the light back in the eyes of anyone who strikes at it. Gives the model Blinding Splendour.

wargear.name: Siren-lute
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hand-held instrument whose cadence is meant to be heard across a battlefield. Gives the model Siren Song.

wargear.name: Trophy cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cloak stitched from the banners and sashes of fallen rivals. Gives the model Collected Glories and +1 Cool.

wargear.name: Pain-glove
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A gauntlet of fine needles that rewards a duellist and wounds his partner in rhythm. Gives the model Exquisite Agony.

wargear.name: Pavane drum
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A drum slung at the hip whose beat sets the pace of the advance. Gives the model Tempo of the Charge.

wargear.name: Screech-field vents
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Tuned vents bolted to the hull that fill the air with a sound like tearing silk. Gives the vehicle Sonic Distortion.

rites.name: The Flawless Host
rites.flavor: To the Third, a victory with a single flaw in it is a defeat in good clothes.
benefits: Palatine Blade squads, Phoenix Terminator Squads and Veteran Tactical and Veteran Assault Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Palatine Blade and Phoenix squads gain +1 Weapon Skill.
All those units gain Immaculate Ranks: they automatically pass Cool Checks while at full strength.
limitations: At least one Palatine Blade squad is required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads.

require.note: Bring at least one Palatine Blade squad.

modifiers.text: The Flawless Host: Immaculate Ranks, Line (1).

rites.name: Symphony of Slaughter
rites.flavor: The battle is only the percussion. The screaming is the melody.
benefits: Kakophoni Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
Kakophoni gain Dirge of Pain: enemy units within 12" suffer -1 to Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two Kakophoni Squads are required.
Every Infantry unit in the army suffers -1 Intelligence from the din.

require.note: Bring at least two Kakophoni Squads.

modifiers.text: Symphony of Slaughter: Dirge of Pain, Fear (1).

rites.name: Descent of the Gilded Wings
rites.flavor: They fall like fireworks and are gone before anyone thinks to look away.
benefits: Palatine Blade Aquilae, Veteran Assault and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Gilded Descent: Deep Strike, and they may Charge in the turn they arrive.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Movement.
limitations: No Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.
At least half of the units with Gilded Descent (rounded up) must start in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Descent of the Gilded Wings: Gilded Descent, Deep Strike.
Descent of the Gilded Wings: +1 M.

rites.name: A Thousand Suns
rites.flavor: Each shot is composed. Each corpse is arranged. Nothing is left to chance but the applause.
benefits: Sun Killer Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and +1 Ballistic Skill.
They gain Composed Volley: Precision (6+) on their Shooting attacks.
limitations: At least two Sun Killer Squads are required.
No Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, and no Rapier or Tarantula Batteries.

require.note: Bring at least two Sun Killer Squads.

modifiers.text: A Thousand Suns: Composed Volley, Precision (6+), Line (1).

rules.name: Immaculate Ranks
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Flawless Host). A unit with this rule automatically passes Cool Checks while it has not lost a model since the start of the battle.

rules.name: Dirge of Pain
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Symphony of Slaughter). While within 12" of a unit with this rule, enemy units suffer -1 to their Cool Checks.

rules.name: Gilded Descent
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Descent of the Gilded Wings). A unit with this rule gains Deep Strike and may Charge in the turn it arrives from Reserve. At least half of the army's units with this rule (rounded up) must start the battle in Reserve.

rules.name: Composed Volley
rules.text: Legacy house rule (A Thousand Suns). A unit with this rule gains Precision (6+) on its Shooting attacks.

rules.name: Blinding Splendour
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While the bearer is in a Challenge, enemy models subtract 1 from their Hit Tests against it.

rules.name: Siren Song
rules.text: Legacy house rule. An enemy unit that begins its Movement phase within 12" of the bearer must pass a Cool Check or it may not Rush that turn.

rules.name: Collected Glories
rules.text: Legacy house rule. When the bearer's unit destroys an enemy Character, the bearer gains Fear (1) for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Exquisite Agony
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Each unsaved Wound the bearer inflicts in melee also gives the target -1 Initiative until the end of that Combat.

rules.name: Tempo of the Charge
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer's unit counts any Charge roll of less than 6 as a 6, once per battle.

rules.name: Sonic Distortion
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Shooting Attacks against the vehicle from more than 18" subtract 1 from their Hit Tests.
